test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The name of which element is derived from an Anglo-Saxon word and its symbol comes from the Latin word ‘Aurum’?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Gold.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Gold** is element **79 **and its symbol is** Au.**
 
• Though the name is **Anglo Saxon, gold originated from the Latin Aurum,** or shining daw
